items.name: theme
items.title: Coreloom theme
items.description: Coreloom UI tokens (dark-first, light via data-theme), the brand fonts (Fontsource) and the Tailwind/shadcn theme layer that maps shadcn color utilities onto the tokens. Import fonts.css, tokens.css and theme.css in your globals.css after tailwindcss. accents.css adds blue, violet, amber and rose presets (data-accent on <html>); surfaces.css adds the mineral and bone surface presets (data-surface).

items.name: utils
items.title: cn()
items.description: Class-name merging helper used by every component.

items.name: i18n
items.title: i18n
items.description: CoreloomI18nProvider and useCoreloomI18n: every built-in string of the components and blocks, in English and French, overridable per string. Spanish and German: @coreloom/i18n-es, @coreloom/i18n-de.

items.name: i18n-es
items.title: i18n — Spanish
items.description: Spanish messages for CoreloomI18nProvider: <CoreloomI18nProvider locale="es" messages={es} dateLocale={…}>.

items.name: i18n-de
items.title: i18n — German
items.description: German messages for CoreloomI18nProvider: <CoreloomI18nProvider locale="de" messages={de} dateLocale={…}>.

items.name: rules
items.title: Rules for AI assistants
items.description: AGENTS.md at the app's root: the Coreloom design, accessibility and text rules, so coding agents (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot…) follow them on every change.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Router-agnostic links: CoreloomLinkProvider gives blocks your router's link (TanStack Router, Next.js…); AppLink falls back to a plain <a>.

items.name: render-icon
items.title: renderIcon()
items.description: Draws an icon given as a Lucide component or as an element; the IconLike type that blocks take for their icon props.

items.name: initials
items.title: initials()
items.description: The letters an avatar shows without a picture: "Ada Lovelace" → "AL".

items.name: use-controllable-state
items.title: useControllableState()
items.description: One value a component's parent may own (`value` + `onChange`) or leave to the component (`defaultValue`), like useState.

items.name: uml
items.title: UML model, Mermaid and PlantUML
items.description: The typed model of class, sequence, state, entity–relationship, C4, use case, activity, deployment, component and package diagrams, parseUmlJson to check JSON from outside, parseMermaid / toMermaid for the matching Mermaid subset (flowcharts read as activity diagrams) and parsePlantUml / toPlantUml for PlantUML (tolerant: problems by line), editing functions (add, connect, rename, change properties, delete; sequence steps; copy and paste; align, distribute and direction) and the layout UmlDiagram draws with. No mermaid or plantuml dependency.

items.name: ai
items.title: AI message types
items.description: The message shapes the AI blocks read, matching the AI SDK's UIMessage (parts: text, reasoning, tools, files, sources), plus cost and duration formatters. No dependency on the AI SDK.

items.name: demo-chat
items.title: useDemoChat
items.description: A stand-in for the AI SDK's useChat that simulates a model in the browser (reasoning, a tool call, an approval, a streamed answer with a source), to prototype AI screens with the Chat block before there is a backend.

items.name: accent
items.title: Accent generator
items.description: generateAccent(hex): a contrast-checked accent family for both themes, and the brand.css that applies it (data-accent). No dependencies.

items.name: vscode
items.title: VS Code webviews
items.description: Coreloom UI inside a VS Code extension's webview: vscode.css maps the tokens onto the editor's --vscode-* variables (light, dark, high contrast, its fonts) and cancels VS Code's default webview styles; syncVsCodeTheme(), useVsCodeState, postToExtension and useExtensionMessages follow the theme, keep state while the tab is hidden and exchange typed messages. Import vscode.css after theme.css.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline status banner for info, success, warning and danger messages.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact mono-type status or metadata pill.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary interactive control, cyan by default.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Elevated surface panel with icon tile, accent glow and mono footer.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Square check control, with indeterminate state.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal window over the Coreloom scrim.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, control, description and error layout for forms.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Lucide icons under the Coreloom icon names.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key for shortcuts.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible form label.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Single choice among a few visible options.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Styled, keyboard-navigable listbox. `onClear` on the trigger adds a clear button.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Hairline divider.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single value or range slider.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Pills or underline tabs.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field that grows with its content.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Inverted hint chip with 400 ms hover delay.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, for small forms and details.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Panel that slides in from an edge of the screen (Drawer).

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Toast notifications (Sonner) themed for Coreloom.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where the current page sits in the hierarchy.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links for long lists and tables.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: Menu of actions opened from a button.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable command list and ⌘K palette (cmdk).

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that expand one at a time.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User or project image with initials fallback.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: List row with media, title, description and actions (List).

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate progress bar.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder shape while content loads.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading indicator.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data table with mono headers and row states.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible app navigation (offcanvas or icon rail) that turns into a Sheet below 768px; Ctrl/Cmd+B toggles it.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A confirmation that must be answered before anything else, for destructive or irreversible actions.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Unstyled show / hide region with a trigger.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state button for formatting and view options.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A row of toggles, single or multiple choice.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: HoverCard
items.description: Preview card shown when hovering a link or name.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: Scroll container with a slim themed scrollbar.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid for picking a date or a range (react-day-picker).

items.name: input-otp
items.title: InputOTP
items.description: One-time code input, one box per character.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty state: icon, title, description and an action.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select built from Popover and Command. `clearable` adds a clear button; `onCreate` offers to create what was searched.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: Date field: a Calendar in a Popover, or with `typing` a text input that reads dates in the locale's order, plus a calendar button.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Table with sorting, filtering, selection and pagination (TanStack Table). With `server`, sorting, search and pagination go to your API (page in, rows and total out). With `virtual`, thousands of rows scroll in a fixed-height box, only the visible ones rendered (TanStack Virtual).

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: FilterBar
items.description: Filters as chips above a list or a table (Add filter, edit a chip's operator and value, remove it, saved views, result count), and QueryBuilder for nested AND / OR groups. The filter is a plain value: run it on rows with matchesFilter, send it to your API, or keep it in the URL with filterToSearchParams.

items.name: virtual-list
items.title: VirtualList
items.description: A long list in a scrolling box with only the visible items rendered (TanStack Virtual): measured item heights, load-more at the end for infinite queries.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: Right-click / long-press menu of actions on an element.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Desktop-app style menu bar (File, Edit, View…).

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: Site navigation with dropdown panels of links.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panel groups the user can resize by dragging or with the keyboard.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Swipeable slides with previous / next buttons (Embla).

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Draggable bottom sheet for phones (vaul).

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts wrapper: container, tooltip and legend on Coreloom tokens, series colors from --chart-1…5.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Word-sized trend (line, area or bars) in plain SVG, with a screen-reader summary: for stat cards, table cells and list rows.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: A whole split into a few parts: SVG ring with the total in the middle and a legend with each value and share; small parts fold into Other.

items.name: bar-list
items.title: Bar list
items.description: Ranking as an HTML list: label over a proportional bar, value at the right, optional links and a Show all button past a limit.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: One value against its range as an open ring (a meter), with optional warning and critical thresholds stated in words.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Values on a grid of squares in five steps of one chart color: a row × column matrix (weekday × hour) and CalendarHeatmap for a year of days. One tab stop with arrow keys, every cell named.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: Steps of a flow as an ordered list: a bar per step against the first, the count, the share of the start and the share that went on to the next step.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Two or three series compared on the same measures, one axis each around a circle; values also in a hidden table.

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter chart
items.description: Two measures across many items, up to three groups and an optional size measure (bubbles); every point in a hidden table.

items.name: treemap-chart
items.title: Treemap chart
items.description: Many parts of a whole as tiles sized by value, colored by up to five groups, labels in roomy tiles; every item with its share in a hidden list.

items.name: sankey-chart
items.title: Sankey chart
items.description: Flows between nodes in columns, bands as wide as the flow, colored by source column; every flow in a hidden list.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: TanStack Form wired to Field: useAppForm with text and textarea (optional character count), password, number, masked (IBAN, card, SIRET), unit, duration, slider, select, segmented, combobox, multi-select, date (picked or typed), time, date and time, month, week, date range, tags, file, money, phone, colour, rating, radio, radio cards, checkbox, checkbox group, switch, key-value, chips, survey scale, number range, time range, JSON, mentions, tree select, transfer list, image, ranking, recurrence, time zone and one-time-code fields, a submit button and form-level errors.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: DateRangePicker
items.description: Date range field: a two-month range Calendar in a Popover, with shortcuts (Last 7 days, This month…).

items.name: tags-input
items.title: TagsInput
items.description: Text field that turns entries into removable tags (Enter, comma or paste).

items.name: file-upload
items.title: FileUpload
items.description: Drop zone and file list with type and size checks, image thumbnails and per-file progress.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a multi-step flow: done, current and upcoming steps, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: Several values from a known list: chips in the trigger, a searchable checklist, select all / clear, an optional maximum.

items.name: money-input
items.title: MoneyInput
items.description: An amount typed the reader's way (1 234,50 / 1,234.50), the currency symbol where the locale puts it; the value is a number.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: PhoneInput
items.description: Country picker and national number, formatted as people write it; the value is E.164 (+33612345678). isValidPhone() included.

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: A field with addons inside its border (icon, prefix, unit, button, kbd, a toolbar above or below a textarea), plus ready-made PasswordInput (show/hide) and SearchInput (clear); `CopyInput` for a read-only value with a copy button.

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Buttons, selects, inputs or a text label joined edge to edge: split buttons, related actions, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: number-input
items.title: NumberInput
items.description: A number typed the reader's way, with − / + buttons and spin-button keys (arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End); units and percents through Intl; the value is a number.

items.name: native-select
items.title: NativeSelect
items.description: The browser's own <select>, styled like the other fields: the best picker on phones and in long forms.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: Keeps a box at a width-to-height ratio (16/9, 1, 4/3) for images, videos and previews.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: A time of day, typed ("14:30", "2:30 pm", "14h30") or picked from a list, shown in the reader's clock; the value is "HH:mm". DateTimePicker joins it with a DatePicker for one Date.

items.name: character-count
items.title: CharacterCount
items.description: "120/280" under a text field: amber near the limit, red past it, announced to screen readers only at thresholds.

items.name: editable-text
items.title: EditableText
items.description: Text that becomes a field when clicked: Enter or blur saves, Escape restores, focus returns to the text. Inherits the surrounding font.

items.name: slider-input
items.title: SliderInput
items.description: A Slider and a NumberInput on one value: drag for a rough value, type an exact one.

items.name: masked-input
items.title: MaskedInput
items.description: A field that groups what people type (IBAN, card, SIREN, SIRET or your own pattern) and checks it (mod 97, Luhn); the value is the raw characters.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: ColorPicker
items.description: A colour as "#rrggbb": swatches, a hex field and the system colour dialog, in a popover.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Stars to give a score (radio buttons: arrows, click again to clear) or to show one read-only, halves included.

items.name: choice-card
items.title: ChoiceCard
items.description: Radio buttons and checkboxes drawn as cards with a title, a description and an icon (RadioCardGroup, RadioCard, CheckboxCard).

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: Two to five options in one pill, exactly one picked ("Day · Week · Month"): a radio group, arrows change the pick.

items.name: unit-input
items.title: UnitInput
items.description: A number with its unit picked beside it ("12 px", "80 kg"); optional conversion when the unit changes.

items.name: duration-input
items.title: DurationInput
items.description: A duration typed the way people say it ("1h30", "90", "1:30"); the value is minutes, shown back in the locale.

items.name: month-picker
items.title: MonthPicker
items.description: A month of a year ("YYYY-MM") from a twelve-month grid, with min and max.

items.name: week-picker
items.title: WeekPicker
items.description: An ISO week ("YYYY-Www") from a calendar with week numbers; clicking a day picks its week.

items.name: key-value-editor
items.title: KeyValueEditor
items.description: Rows of key and value people add and remove (headers, variables); flags repeated keys and splits pasted "KEY=value" lines.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: EmojiPicker
items.description: A built-in set of common emoji by category, searchable, with arrow-key navigation; as a popover button or a panel.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: SignaturePad
items.description: A box to sign with a finger, pen or mouse, or type one's name instead; the value is a PNG data URL.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: PasswordStrength
items.description: A strength meter and rule checklist under a new-password field; announced only when the level changes.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: ChipGroup
items.description: Pills that toggle on and off (filters, interests): checkboxes with type="multiple", radios with type="single".

items.name: scale-input
items.title: ScaleInput
items.description: A survey scale, NPS 0–10 or a worded Likert scale: a radio group with end labels.

items.name: range-inputs
items.title: NumberRangeInput / TimeRangePicker
items.description: Two fields for the two ends of a range (a price filter, opening hours); an upside-down range is flagged, overnight allowed.

items.name: json-input
items.title: JsonInput
items.description: A code field for JSON: says where it breaks (line, column), Format re-indents, Tab indents.

items.name: mention-textarea
items.title: MentionTextarea
items.description: A textarea where "@" suggests people (or "#" channels); arrows and Enter insert the handle. mentionsIn lists them.

items.name: tree-select
items.title: TreeSelect
items.description: A select whose options nest, with an APG tree in the popover; one value or several.

items.name: transfer-list
items.title: TransferList
items.description: Two filterable lists, Available and Selected, with buttons to move ticked items between them.

items.name: image-input
items.title: ImageInput
items.description: One image with its preview (avatar, logo, cover): click or drop to choose, replace or remove; type and size checked.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: SortableList
items.description: Items to put in order (a ranking): drag by the handle, with the keyboard, or with up and down buttons; announced to screen readers.

items.name: recurrence-input
items.title: RecurrenceInput
items.description: How often something repeats (every 2 weeks on Mon and Wed, until a date or N times), read back as a sentence; toRRule and parseRRule convert to iCalendar RRULE.

items.name: timezone-select
items.title: TimezoneSelect
items.description: Searchable IANA time zones with their UTC offsets, the person's own zone marked. Built on Combobox.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: RelativeTime
items.description: A date said the way people say it ("5 minutes ago", "yesterday"), kept up to date, with the full date in its tooltip.

items.name: save-status
items.title: SaveStatus
items.description: Where an autosaving document stands: "Saved · 2 minutes ago", "Saving…", "Unsaved changes" or "Couldn't save" with Retry; one polite status message, not one per save.

items.name: suggestion-list
items.title: SuggestionList
items.description: Suggestions reviewed one by one before they count (rules a model proposes, tags, fixes): Accept, Edit then accept, or Ignore each one; the outcome is announced and focus moves to the next.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events in order on a line: icon or dot markers tinted by tone, title, time, description and any content below.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: TreeView
items.description: A hierarchy to browse (files, pages, an organisation): APG tree keyboard, icons and trailing meta, read only or with single or multiple selection.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.title: DiffViewer
items.description: What changed between two texts, line by line, unified or split, with unchanged runs folded; diffLines is exported.

items.name: code-editor
items.title: CodeEditor
items.description: Code to write, on CodeMirror 6 in Coreloom's colours: JS/TS (JSX), JSON, CSS, HTML, Markdown and Python, folding, autocompletion, search, diagnostics by line, Mod-S, one undo history per file path.

items.name: code-viewer
items.title: CodeViewer
items.description: Code to read with line numbers, highlighted lines, wrap toggle and Copy; colour it per line with your highlighter.

items.name: ansi-output
items.title: AnsiOutput
items.description: Program output with its ANSI colours (16, 256, true colour), styles, OSC 8 links and progress-bar rewrites; an incremental parser (writeAnsi) for streamed chunks.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A command line in the page: prompt, history, Tab completion, ANSI output, Ctrl+C; commands are your callback (text, promise or stream, read() for questions) or a PTY-shaped session.

items.name: log-viewer
items.title: LogViewer
items.description: A long log, virtualized: ANSI colours, levels and timestamps detected from text, search with marked words, level filters, wrap, follow the end, copy.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JsonViewer
items.description: JSON to explore: objects and arrays fold, values coloured by type, Expand all, Collapse all and Copy.

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: Labels and their values, stacked, inline or in a grid; empty values say "Not set", Copy for IDs.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: StatusIndicator
items.description: A coloured dot and the word for it, plain or in a pill, with an optional pulse; StatusDot alone.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A message across the top of a page or app, by tone, with an action and an optional close button.

items.name: truncated-text
items.title: TruncatedText
items.description: A long text cut after a few lines, with Show more when it is actually cut.

items.name: highlight
items.title: Highlight
items.description: Marks searched terms in a text, ignoring case and accents; findMatches is exported.

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: A guided tour: steps that light up a target and explain it, with Back, Next, Skip and a step count.

items.name: image-gallery
items.title: ImageGallery
items.description: A grid of thumbnails opening a full-screen viewer with arrows, zoom and captions; ImageLightbox alone.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: CommentThread
items.description: Comments with one level of replies, emoji reactions, @ mentions and a box to write; front-end only.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of tools that is one Tab stop with arrow-key navigation: buttons, toggles, links, separators, named menus (Add ▾) and a More menu.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: ActionBar
items.description: A bar for the selected items with their count, bulk actions and a way to clear the selection.

items.name: popconfirm
items.title: Popconfirm
items.description: A small confirmation anchored to the button that asked for it, with Cancel first and an async confirm.

items.name: secret-value
items.title: SecretValue
items.description: An API key or token shown as dots, with Show and Copy.

items.name: format
items.title: FormatNumber
items.description: Numbers, percentages, currencies, compact numbers and bytes written for the locale; AnimatedNumber counts up to a value.

items.name: notification-badge
items.title: NotificationBadge
items.description: A count or a dot on the corner of an icon or avatar, capped at 99+, with the count in words for screen readers.

items.name: overflow-list
items.title: OverflowList
items.description: A one-line row of chips or avatars that shows what fits and ends with +N opening the rest.

items.name: file-card
items.title: FileCard
items.description: An attached file with its type icon or thumbnail, size, upload progress, error and Retry, Remove; FileCardList.

items.name: keyboard-shortcuts
items.title: KeyboardShortcuts
items.description: useHotkeys for combinations and sequences, Hotkey to draw them, and ShortcutsDialog listing an app’s shortcuts.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: The time left until a moment, as a clock, boxes or a short phrase, with onComplete.

items.name: quota-bar
items.title: QuotaBar
items.description: How much of a limit is used, split by segment, with the total, a legend and amber or red near the limit.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Content that fades, slides, scales, comes into focus or is uncovered by a mask (wipes, circle) as it scrolls into view, once; Stagger does it item by item. With useInView and useReducedMotion.

items.name: text-effects
items.title: Text effects
items.description: WordReveal (words arrive one by one), Typewriter (typed phrases with a caret), ShimmerText (a light sweeping a 'Thinking…' label), GradientText and ScrambleText (letters that decode).

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: Your logo, handled once: inline SVG or image (light and dark versions), a name for screen readers, an optional link home, and entrance animations (fade, stagger, draw, assemble, wipe, shine, pulse) on mount, in view or on hover.

items.name: logo-loader
items.title: Logo loader
items.description: Your logo as the loading screen of the app or a panel: it breathes or draws itself, then fades away and hands over to the content, announced as a busy status.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: A row of customer or partner logos, in a grid or a scrolling marquee, muted until hovered, with names for screen readers and optional links.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A row or column of logos or quotes that scrolls without end, with faded edges, a pause button and a stop on hover and focus.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: Spotlight (a soft light that follows the pointer across a card) and BorderGlow (a light running along the border).

items.name: view-transition
items.title: useViewTransition
items.description: Page and view changes with the View Transitions API: fade, slide, slide-back or scale, straight away where unsupported or with reduced motion.

items.name: animated-icon
items.title: Animated icons
items.description: DrawIcon (a check, cross or arrow that draws itself), MorphIcon (one icon turning into another) and MenuToggleIcon (menu lines folding into a cross).

items.name: status-button
items.title: StatusButton
items.description: A button that shows its action: a spinner while it runs, a drawn check on success, a shake on error, each announced.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: AnimatedList
items.description: A list whose keyed items slide open when added and fold away when removed.

items.name: animated-height
items.title: AnimatedHeight
items.description: A box that animates to the height of its content when the content changes.

items.name: tabs-indicator
items.title: TabsIndicator
items.description: A highlight or underline that slides to the active tab of a TabsList.

items.name: ping
items.title: Ping
items.description: A pulsing dot on any element (new, unread, live), with a label for screen readers; PingDot alone.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: fireConfetti: a short confetti burst from an element or a point, with the Web Animations API; nothing with reduced motion.

items.name: page-progress
items.title: PageProgress
items.description: A thin bar at the top of the page while the next page loads.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: TypingIndicator
items.description: Three bobbing dots while someone is typing, said once to screen readers.

items.name: scroll-effects
items.title: Scroll effects
items.description: ScrollProgress (a reading bar) and Parallax (a layer that drifts as it crosses the screen), with CSS scroll-driven animations.

items.name: animated-background
items.title: AnimatedBackground
items.description: A slowly moving grid, dots or aurora behind a hero or a sign-in page.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: TiltCard
items.description: A card that tilts toward the pointer, with an optional glare.

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: RichTextEditor
items.description: Tiptap editor with a toolbar (marks, headings, lists, quote, code, links, undo), an optional AI panel (⌘J) fed by your own onRequest, with rewrites reviewed as changes to accept or reject, and RichTextField for the form kit; the value is HTML.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Model output (or any Markdown) in Coreloom type: GitHub-flavoured tables, task lists, code blocks with copy; raw HTML is dropped; fenced code in a registered language goes to the app's renderer (diagrams with DiagramCodeBlock). A caret while streaming.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: PromptInput
items.description: The composer for a chat: grows with the text, Enter sends, attachments, Send turns into Stop while a reply streams, a toolbar slot.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: A model's thinking folded under one line: open while it streams, "Thought for 6 s" once done.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: ToolCall
items.description: One tool call from an agent: name, state, input and output, and Allow / Deny when it needs approval. Reads an AI SDK tool part.

items.name: agent-avatar
items.title: AgentAvatar
items.description: A small animated face for an AI agent (face or dots): idle, thinking, speaking, done, error, offline, with a stable colour and eyes per seed.

items.name: agent-plan
items.title: AgentPlan
items.description: The steps an agent works through, ticked off live (to do, in progress, done, failed, skipped) from a `data-plan` part.

items.name: tool-form
items.title: ToolForm
items.description: A tool that asks the person with a form (date, choice, text) before it goes on; the answer becomes the tool's output (`addToolOutput`).

items.name: form-renderer
items.title: FormRenderer
items.description: Builds a form at runtime from a FormSpec (JSON sections, fields, checks and conditions) with the Form fields (45 types, from text to recurrence); readFormSpec reads untrusted specs, fromJSONSchema / toJSONSchema convert from and to JSON Schema, and formFieldTypes is the registry of field types you extend.

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: InlineCitation
items.description: A numbered citation in a model's text: hover, focus or tap shows the source (title, site or file, link). Reads an AI SDK source part.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: ModelPicker
items.description: Pick the model that answers: a ghost or outline trigger opening a searchable list grouped by provider, with context window, price per million tokens and capabilities. ModelList shows the list inline.

items.name: model-field
items.title: ModelField
items.description: ModelPicker in the form kit: an outline, full-width picker inside <form.AppField>, labelled by the field's label; the value is the model's id.

items.name: agent-graph
items.title: AgentGraph
items.description: A multi-agent system as a graph: agents as cards, teams as frames, links for delegation, handoffs and the tools and knowledge they use. Laid out in layers without a graph library; keyboard navigation, a list view, zoom, and a run shown live.

items.name: node-editor
items.title: NodeEditor
items.description: An n8n-style canvas on React Flow: the app's node kinds (ports, settings, icon), add from a searchable list, drag, connect output to input, configure and connect from a side panel (the keyboard path), undo/redo, tidy up, zoom, issues flagged, a run's state shown per node; each node's input and output, `{{ }}` expressions with suggestions and a preview, "Test node" through a callback, conditions, key/value, JSON and credential fields; pinned sample data, "+" on outputs and connections, copy/paste, right-click menus and disabled nodes; notes and groups on the canvas, a minimap and Find (Ctrl/⌘+F). Nothing runs inside.

items.name: uml-diagram
items.title: UmlDiagram
items.description: Software diagrams from the UML model: class, state, ER, C4, use case, activity, deployment, component and package on a React Flow canvas laid out automatically (UML markers, crow's feet, frames, multiplicities; zoom, fit; with `editable`, draggable, and selection, box selection, align and distribute, drag-to-connect, Delete, F2 or double-click rename and drops from a toolbar for apps that edit the model), sequence diagrams as an SVG with the steps as a list for screen readers; SVG and PNG images through a ref.

items.name: diagram-code-block
items.title: DiagramCodeBlock
items.description: Draws ```mermaid and ```plantuml blocks of a Markdown answer as diagrams with UmlDiagram (class, sequence, state, ER, C4, use case, activity, deployment, component, package), with a Diagram / Source switch; the plain code block while streaming or when the text can't be read. Register it once around a chat with MarkdownCodeBlocksContext.

items.name: context-meter
items.title: ContextMeter
items.description: How full the context window is: a ring or bar and a percentage (amber from 80 %, red from 95 %), with the token breakdown and estimated cost on hover or focus. Reads the AI SDK's usage.

items.name: all
items.title: Coreloom UI — every light component
items.description: Theme, utils and every Coreloom UI component that needs no heavy library, in one install. Add `charts`, `editors`, `node-editor` and `uml-diagram` for the rest, or install `everything`.

items.name: charts
items.title: Coreloom UI — Recharts charts
items.description: The charts drawn with Recharts: Chart (area, bar, line, pie), RadarChart, ScatterChart, TreemapChart and SankeyChart. The light charts (Sparkline, DonutChart, BarList, Gauge, Heatmap, FunnelChart) are in `all`.

items.name: editors
items.title: Coreloom UI — editors
items.description: The editors built on large libraries: RichTextEditor (Tiptap) and CodeEditor (CodeMirror).

items.name: everything
items.title: Coreloom UI — everything
items.description: Every Coreloom UI component in one install: `all`, `charts`, `editors`, `node-editor`, `uml-diagram` and `diagram-code-block`.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: ThemeToggle
items.description: ThemeToggle (light ↔ dark), ThemeMenu (Light, Dark, System) and AccentPicker (the accent presets), with useTheme and useAccent. Choices are saved in localStorage.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: CommandMenu
items.description: The ⌘K palette: a header search button and a CommandDialog fed with plain data, with an optional "Ask AI" item (onAskAi).

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Copies a string, confirms with a check and a toast.

items.name: site-header
items.title: SiteHeader
items.description: Sticky site bar with brand, links and actions; links move into a Sheet on phones.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: SiteFooter
items.description: Footer with a note and links; with brand and columns, a multi-column site footer (link columns, address, social links).

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Product layout: collapsible sidebar with workspace switcher and account menu, sticky header with breadcrumb, ⌘K palette and theme toggle, page header and stat cards.

items.name: auth
items.title: Auth screens
items.description: Sign-in, sign-up, code verification, forgot-password and reset-password forms on @coreloom/form (TanStack Form), with a centered layout.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Settings layout with section nav, form sections (a TanStack form or plain inputs) with a save footer, switch rows and a danger zone with typed confirmation.

items.name: marketing
items.title: Marketing page
items.description: Landing sections: site header, hero with install command, feature grid, FAQ, call to action and footer.

items.name: showcase
items.title: Showcase site
items.description: Sections for a business's public site (a practice, a studio, a firm): hero with an image, practitioner cards, contact details with opening hours and a map, image + text sections, quotes and a legal page layout. Pair with surfaces.css for the page's backgrounds.

items.name: docs
items.title: Docs layout
items.description: Documentation layout: nav column (Sheet on phones), article, scroll-spy table of contents, code blocks and Preview / Code tabs.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: Stat grid, chart card with a ready-made trend chart (area, bars, lines; stacked, 100 % or combo with a second axis) and an activity feed.

items.name: data-list
items.title: Data list
items.description: Search, faceted filters with counts and pagination, with the state kept in the URL.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Plan cards with a monthly / yearly switch, locale-formatted prices and a featured plan.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: Multi-step setup: a Stepper, the step's content in a card, Back / Continue / Finish.

items.name: error-pages
items.title: Error pages
items.description: 404, 500 and maintenance pages, plus the bare ErrorPage layout for any other status.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: A bell with the unread count and a popover of notifications: all / unread, mark one or all as read, links.

items.name: team
items.title: Team
items.description: Workspace members with roles, an invite dialog (several emails, one role), pending invites and confirmed removal.

items.name: gantt
items.title: Gantt
items.description: A roadmap on a timeline: bars with progress, milestones, dependency arrows, groups, a today line and a day / week / month zoom; bars move and resize with the mouse or the keyboard (onTaskChange).

items.name: status-page
items.title: Status page
items.description: A public status page: the overall state, each component with 90 days of uptime, ongoing incidents with their updates, and past incidents; UptimeBar and IncidentTimeline work alone too.

items.name: api-keys
items.title: API keys
items.description: The workspace's API keys (visible ends, access, created, last used, expiry) with Create (the secret shown once, with Copy) and confirmed Revoke.

items.name: webhooks
items.title: Webhooks
items.description: Webhook endpoints with their events, on / off, the signing secret, and each endpoint's deliveries with payload, response and Redeliver.

items.name: api-try-it
items.title: API try it
items.description: The "Try it" panel of an API reference page: path, query and header parameters, headers, a JSON body, Send and Cancel, the status, time, body and headers that came back, and Copy as cURL. The app makes the call through onSend.

items.name: security-settings
items.title: Security settings
items.description: Two-step sign-in with an authenticator app (setup, code check, recovery codes, turn off) and the active sessions with Sign out.

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit log
items.description: Who did what and when, grouped by day, with search, actor and action filters, each event's details, Export and Load more.

items.name: integrations
items.title: Integrations
items.description: The apps a workspace can connect, as cards with search and category filters; Connect, Configure and confirmed Disconnect are callbacks.

items.name: prompt-manager
items.title: Prompt manager
items.description: One prompt and its versions: edit with {{variables}} found as you type, save a version, compare two as a diff, deploy to a label and test with a streamed answer.

items.name: billing
items.title: Billing
items.description: Current plan, usage meters against limits, payment method and invoices, in the reader's currency format.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: Columns of cards to reorder and move by drag and drop (pointer or keyboard, announced) or from a Move to menu; WIP limits.

items.name: file-manager
items.title: File manager
items.description: Folders and files in a grid or a list: breadcrumb, multi-selection, drag and drop onto folders (or Move to), uploads dropped from the computer and a details panel.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: Shared conversations for a support or sales team: list with search and filters, thread with internal notes and attachments, reply or note composer, status and assignee. A base for a helpdesk.

items.name: spreadsheet
items.title: Spreadsheet
items.description: An editable grid like a spreadsheet: keyboard navigation, type or Enter to edit, range selection, copy, cut and paste as TSV with Excel or Google Sheets, undo, and a sum of the numbers selected.

items.name: workflow-builder
items.title: Workflow builder
items.description: An automation's page: its name, Save and Run (waiting until no node needs attention) above the node editor with your app's node kinds; onRun hands the graph to your app, which reports each node's state through runs.

items.name: diagram-editor
items.title: Diagram editor
items.description: Software diagrams as text: Mermaid, PlantUML (class, sequence, state, ER, C4, use case, activity, deployment, component, package) or UML JSON beside the drawing, with drawing tools (add or drag elements, connect, delete, copy, paste, duplicate, layout direction, undo, redo) and a properties panel (class members line by line, sequence participants, messages, notes, activations and blocks) that change the model and rewrite the text; problems marked on their line, draggable elements whose positions go in the JSON, format switch, templates, copy, and download as text, SVG or PNG.

items.name: diagram-card
items.title: Diagram card
items.description: A gallery card for a diagram document: a thumbnail (UmlDiagram preview or an image URL, a neutral drawing when there's neither), the title as a link over the whole card, a visibility badge (private, public, protected), the number of diagrams, when it changed, and a … menu of actions.

items.name: share-dialog
items.title: Share dialog
items.description: A dialog to choose who can open a document (private, public with the link, protected with the link and a code), applied through an async call with a spinner and a revert on error; the link with Copy and Regenerate, the code hidden in SecretValue with Generate a new code (both asked first), and Copy link and code.

items.name: access-code-gate
items.title: Access code gate
items.description: The screen in front of a protected link: one box per character of the access code (8 by default, letters upper-cased, characters outside the alphabet ignored), sent by itself when full, pasted codes, attempts left, and a countdown while locked. Goes in AuthLayout.

items.name: diagram-viewer
items.title: Diagram viewer
items.description: A document of several UML diagrams to read: title, description and date, the views in tabs (a side list past six, a menu on a phone), the diagram with zoom and full screen, SVG and PNG downloads, and arrows or Page Up / Page Down to change view. No editing tools.

items.name: diagram-workspace
items.title: Diagram workspace
items.description: The editor of a document with several diagrams: its name in place (EditableText), the save state (SaveStatus), the list of views (add a chosen kind, rename, reorder with SortableList, delete after a confirmation, never the last one), and a controlled DiagramEditor for the open view. On a phone the list moves into a Sheet.

items.name: form-builder
items.title: Form builder
items.description: Makes a form without code: a palette of field types, a live canvas to arrange them (drag and drop, sections in columns), an inspector for each field's label, checks, options and conditions, a Preview and the form's JSON (FormSpec or JSON Schema), plus import from a FormSpec or a JSON Schema.

items.name: ide
items.title: IDE
items.description: A code workspace laid out like VS Code, in the browser: file explorer, tabs, CodeMirror editor, Problems and your own bottom panels, status bar, Mod-P file search and a command palette; saving, running and diagnostics are your app's callbacks.

items.name: code-review
items.title: Code review
items.description: A pull request to review: changed files in a tree, unified or split diffs with a comment button on every line, threads under their lines (reply, resolve), Viewed per file and Finish review with a verdict; comments and the review are your app's callbacks.

items.name: terminal-console
items.title: Terminal console
items.description: Several terminals in tabs, as in an IDE's panel: New terminal with a menu of profiles, side by side split, Close; each terminal is a controller your app creates, so output survives tab switches.

items.name: pipeline-run
items.title: Pipeline run
items.description: One run of a CI pipeline or a deploy: status, duration, jobs, steps and each step's searchable ANSI log; the failed step opens by itself; Re-run and Cancel are your callbacks.

items.name: event-calendar
items.title: Event calendar
items.description: A month of events: grid on wide screens, agenda on phones, locale week start, n more, today.

items.name: ai-chat
items.title: AI chat
items.description: A conversation with a model for the AI SDK's useChat: Markdown answers, reasoning, tool calls with approval, live agent plans, sources, files, copy / regenerate / feedback, suggestions, and the conversation history.

items.name: ai-chat-widget
items.title: AI chat widget
items.description: A support chat in the page's corner: a launcher with an unread count and a greeting that opens the Chat in a card (a full-screen sheet on phones).

items.name: ai-artifact
items.title: AI artifact panel
items.description: A document or code a model wrote, in a panel beside the chat: versions, Preview / Source, a line diff of the changes, Copy, Download and Restore; with the card a message shows and a resizable chat-and-panel layout.

items.name: ai-agents
items.title: AI agents
items.description: The agents as cards (status, model, tools, last run) and an agent's settings on the form kit: instructions with {{variables}}, model, temperature, steps, tools that ask first, knowledge.

items.name: ai-runs
items.title: AI runs and traces
items.description: An agent's runs in a table, and one run's trace: a waterfall of model calls, tools and retrievals with each step's input, output, tokens, cost and error.

items.name: ai-evals
items.title: AI evaluations
items.description: Eval suites with pass rate, threshold and trend; one run case by case with scores, the judge’s verdict and metrics; two runs compared with regressions, improvements and a split diff of the outputs.

items.name: ai-agent-teams
items.title: AI agent teams
items.description: Agents and their teams as a graph with a team filter and a panel on the selected agent (role, model, who it reports to, delegates and hands off to, what it uses), plus agentActivityFromSpans to show a run live from its trace.

items.name: ai-agent-builder
items.title: AI agent builder
items.description: Design an agent graph the LangGraph way: shared state with replace/append reducers, agent, tools, function, router (one output per route), human review and subgraph nodes between START and END; per-node state reads and writes, structured output (JSON Schema), tool parameters, step limits, pauses before or after a node and a review dialog to approve, edit or reject paused tool calls; LangGraph JSON export and import (the shape of get_graph().to_json()) and the compile() / invoke() config.

items.name: ai-playground
items.title: AI playground
items.description: One prompt, up to three variants side by side (model, temperature) to compare answers, latency, tokens and cost.

items.name: ai-knowledge
items.title: AI knowledge base
items.description: The documents agents search, with indexing status and progress, upload, re-index and remove, and a retrieval test with scored passages.

items.name: audio-recorder
items.title: AudioRecorder
items.description: Records a voice note from the microphone: live waveform and timer, pause, stop, then playback and delete; DictationButton records for a composer, hands the audio to your onTranscribe and gives the text back. useAudioRecorder for your own UI.

items.name: media-player
items.title: MediaPlayer
items.description: A video or audio player with its own controls: seek bar with chapter marks, back and forward, speed, captions (WebVTT), volume, full screen and keyboard shortcuts; chapters and a clickable transcript that follows playback. parseVtt reads a captions file into transcript lines.

items.name: booking
items.title: Booking
items.description: Online appointment booking in three steps: a service, a day in the calendar and a free time (loaded through onLoadSlots), then a recap with the visitor's details and Confirm (onBook); a confirmation with its reference and an Add to calendar (.ics) link. An aside slot for a PractitionerCard or OpeningHours.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Customer quotes as cards: an even grid (a featured quote spans two columns) or a wall of columns with "Show more"; avatar, logo, rating and source on each.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: Plans side by side, feature by feature, under a sticky header: ticks, dashes, "Partial" or values with words for screen readers, "Only show differences", and one plan at a time on phones.

items.name: changelog
items.title: Changelog
items.description: A public changelog page: entries with date, version, media and changes tagged New, Improved, Fixed, Security or Deprecated; a filter by kind, anchors, a feed link and older entries on demand.

items.name: blog
items.title: Blog
items.description: A blog index with a featured post, cards, a category filter and "More posts"; an article page with a table of contents, authors and related posts; author cards and pages.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter
items.description: An email sign-up for a newsletter (onSubscribe) or a launch waitlist (onJoin, with the place in line and a link to share): checks the address, shows the wait, the error and a focused thank-you.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: A cookie banner with "Reject all" and "Accept all" of equal weight, a preferences dialog with a switch per category, and parseConsent to read stored choices back.

items.name: shop
items.title: Shop
items.description: A light shop without payment: product cards and grid, a product page with images, colour swatches, sizes, stock and quantity, a cart with an order summary (promo code, shipping, tax), a cart sheet and button; cartTotals and findVariant included.

items.name: voice-agent
items.title: Voice agent
items.description: The face of a spoken conversation with an AI: an avatar that listens, thinks and speaks, a level meter, a push-to-talk button (hold, Space, or hands-free) and the live transcript. The app owns the microphone and the model.

items.name: load-more
items.title: LoadMore
items.description: The end of a list or feed that loads its next page: a Load more button, or infinite scroll with `auto`, with loading, error (Try again) and end states; loadMoreStatus reads a TanStack infinite query.

items.name: presence
items.title: Presence
items.description: Who else is here: PresenceAvatars (stacked avatars with what each person is doing), PresenceActivity ("Ada is editing…") and RemoteCursors (other people’s pointers with their names). No transport: your app passes positions in.

items.name: image-crop
items.title: ImageCrop
items.description: Frame part of an image before upload: drag or arrow keys to move, zoom slider, fixed ratio, round frame for avatars; cropImage draws the result into a new File and ImageCropDialog asks for it in a dialog.

items.name: dotenv
items.title: parseDotenv()
items.description: Reads the text of a .env file into entries (comments, export, quotes and escapes), listing the lines it can’t read instead of throwing.

items.name: notification-preferences
items.title: Notification preferences
items.description: Which notifications someone gets and where: events (grouped) by channels (e-mail, push, in-app), a checkbox per cell and per channel, required and unavailable cells.

items.name: env-vars
items.title: Environment variables
items.description: A project’s environment variables per environment: secret values masked, Add, Edit, Delete, Import a pasted .env (previewed first) and Compare environments to see what is missing or different.

items.name: feature-flags
items.title: Feature flags
items.description: Feature flags per environment: on / off switches, rollout percentage, targeting rules (first match wins) and history in a side panel; evaluateFeatureFlag shows the logic your server applies.

items.name: version-history
items.title: Version history
items.description: The saved versions of a document, diagram or prompt by day: name a version, see it or its changes against the previous or current one (DiffViewer), and restore it.

items.name: sql-explorer
items.title: SQL explorer
items.description: Query a database from the browser: schema tree, query tabs, a SQL editor with schema completion, Run (Mod-Enter, the selection or everything) and Cancel, results in a virtual table with CSV export. Your onRun returns the rows.

items.name: ai-agent-replay
items.title: AI agent run replay
items.description: Replay a finished multi-agent run from its trace spans: the agent graph at each moment, play or scrub the timeline, the numbered turns, and per-agent turns, time, tokens, tool calls, cost and errors.
